title: Chad1000X
creator: CrossFit
description: 1,000 weighted box step-ups on a 20 in box with a 45/35 lb ruck, for time. Honours U.S. Navy SEAL Senior Chief Chad Wilkinson, who died by suicide in 2018 after service-related brain injuries and PTSD; the CrossFit community repeats it every Veterans Day for veteran mental health. Intermediate is a 30/20 lb ruck; beginner is 500 unweighted step-ups on a 12 in box.
